{{Quote|The crash site was of a starship, named 'the Jade Starunner', and belonged to a war hero, Vendi Kjleno. Unfortunately, I couldn't find enough information about the war hero, only that he was in the Battle of Yavin 4.|Excerpt from [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]]'s log|<ref name="SWG:AEL7" />}}
The '''''Jade Starunner''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in operation during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The vessel was owned by [[Vendi Kjleno]], a war hero of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who fought during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:AEL7" /> By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Kjleno was attacked by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. The ''Jade Starunner'' was shot down above the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] and Vendi Kjleno was killed. A short time later, an [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] by the name [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]] found the crash site of the ''Jade Starunner'' on Endor. In the wreckage, the explorer discovered a damaged [[Datacard/Legends|datadisk]] containing information about the last flight of the ''Jade Starunner'' and the fate of the war hero.<ref name="SWG:AEL7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The wreckage of the ''Jade Starunner'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The wreckage was one of many unmarked points of interests on the moon Endor.<ref name="SWG" /> Following the release of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' expansion pack in [[2004]], rare [[W:c:swg:Data Storage Unit|data storage unit]] devices could sometimes be [[W:c:swg:Loot|looted]] during space battles. One such data storage item, named "an Explorer's Log (7/8)," contained a detailed backstory for the ''Jade Starunner''.<ref name="SWG:AEL7" />
